answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, and publish one signed identity beacon that peers can check. A newcomer starts at jade tier: trusted only for tiny deals until it builds a history of honest work. Sybils drown in the ocean of verification, because each fake identity needs its own stake, its own beacon, and its own slow climb from jade tier, while one caught cheating loses the stake and burns the beacon for all its identities. Honest agents pay once and trade freely; attackers pay per fake and gain nothing.
